changes.what: a test that is a script runs inside a try block
changes.reason: the shell's load() reports an exception that ends a file and throws its own instead; the block hands the test's exception to the prelude first, with every line where upstream has it
each assertion a test makes is recorded with its line, and a failed one lets the file go on instead of ending it, so an engine is held to every assertion and not only to the first it fails

changes.what: assert.soon waits at most a minute
changes.reason: the shell's default is ten minutes; a condition a reference meets at once would hold an engine that never meets it for the file's whole deadline

changes.what: the shell is logged in by a relay of the harness
changes.reason: the legacy shell's SCRAM client refuses salts of other lengths than MongoDB's, which some engines use; a local relay logs every connection the shell opens in as the run's login and passes the messages through unchanged, on every target alike; tests about authentication are left out

changes.what: each release's own legacy shell runs its tests
changes.reason: resmoke runs each release's tests with a shell built from the same release, which MongoDB does not publish after 6.0.0-alpha1; the suite builds it from the release's source tag in the image third_party/jstests/manifest.yaml pins
